description:
The CXC has been updated and it is now in its 4th iteration. With this new edition we have swapped the brake mounts for Flat Mount.

We have also swapped the traditional binder bolt for af collar that adds a more strength and replaceability should any thing brake.

A SWISS ARMY KNIFE

Meet the Omnium CXC, our most adaptable all-rounder. It’s built for riders who want a bike that handles city commutes, all road, and weekend adventures with ease.

The CXC combines the quick, responsive feel of a track bike with the clearance and mounts of an all road setup. It’s tough, agile, and ready to ride anywhere you want to go.

Made from double-butted steel, the frame balances everyday durability with a responsive feel. It’s ED-coated for extra protection against the elements, so you can ride year-round without worry. Adjustable rocker dropouts and a belt split let you choose your setup — geared, single-speed, or belt-drive.

The segmented steel fork is designed for disc brakes and features triple cage mounts on both legs, giving you plenty of space for bottles or bags when you’re loading up. Add racks, fenders, and wide tires — the CXC is built to adapt to your needs.

Whether you’re tackling your daily commute, exploring back roads, or hitting the track, the CXC delivers a fast, agile, and reliable ride every time.

Gears are great, but they also require maintance and have moving parts that can break – When it comes to simplicity, nothing beats single speed.With the one right gear urban commuting is as simple and enjoyable as it will ever be.

Apex is SRAM’s dedicated gravel groupset, a 1×11 groupset with wide range and is simple to use. With a long cage that fits a 42-tooth cassette and the X-HORIZON design reduces shifting force adding extra comfort. It also comes with Sram CAGE LOCK making wheel removal and maintenance much easier.

Run full mudguards and up to 45mm tires, racks, bags and go camping, or strip it down and mash out some kilometers of mixed terrain in turbo mode. There is nothing more versatile.

Getting the perfect fit makes all the difference in how your Omnium feels and performs. Use the chart to find the frame size that best matches your height.

Each Omnium frame size covers a range of rider heights, so if you’re between sizes, consider how you like your bike to feel:
